title: Complete startup of the countdown
statement: For every binary input $x$, after exactly $2|x|+2$ steps from the countdown machine’s initial configuration on $x$, the machine is in its borrow phase with work tape containing $x$, work-head position $0$, input head at the right boundary position $|x|+1$, and empty output.
replaced: For every input $x$, the $(2|x| + 2)$-step run of the countdown emitter from its blank-tape initial configuration is the borrow-state configuration at cell zero with the full input $x$ as counter, input head at the right boundary and empty output.
